title: Notice on Binance Spot API Upgrade (2025-07-08)
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, In order to improve the trading experience of Spot API users,  WebSockets Streams  will undergo an upgrade from  2025-07-08 07:00 (UTC) . During the upgrade,  existing and new connections may disconnect earlier than the usual 24 hours duration.  The upgrade may take up to 2 hours. Notes: Spot trading will not be impacted during the upgrade. API user’s existing programs that rely on market data may experience failures following the upgrade.  More information is available at  Binance Spot API Doc .  There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.  Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-07-03
